overview: Easels, canvases and dye: paint pixel art by hand, cell by cell, with a vanilla client.
Sign what you made and it comes off the easel as a painting you can hang on any wall.

1.0.1: An advancement for painting, signing and hanging a full four by four canvas: two hundred and fifty-six pixels across, which nobody fills by accident.
1.0.0: Place an easel, rub dye into its palette, stretch a canvas one to sixteen blocks across it, and paint with a brush one to four wide.
Colours mix in quarter dyes and show the exact shade they will land on, and each one drains as you use it. Sign the canvas and it becomes a painting named for its title and its painter.
